items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: there was a tap room where Roy Searcy and the guys were working

ctx.x: Claxton and I can't remember who the other -- then Baby Love tt and -- I can't remember the name of the bass player. But now, this was an immediate circle. There was a woman named Edison that worked across the street from us that was -- further out on 12th Street there was a tap room where Roy Searcy and the guys were working, and a little further out there just before you get to the Sunset there was like an open thing, more or less like the old Metropole used to look, where Jack Parker had a group in.

And then in -- two doors or more on that same side of the street was the Lone Star, where Pete Johnson was working, and then over -- directly across from the Lone Star was the Sunset. And that was on 12th Street. Now, over on 18th Street we had the --
